name: The Malibu Sauna
description:
The perfect combination of elegance and beauty, the Malibu infrared sauna will certainly deliver. This is our most popular sauna, Easy to assemble and portable. It only requires a standard 120 Vac electrical socket. Perfect for 1 or 2 people to enjoy the sauna benefits that you will get using in this sauna !

The Malibu Sauna impressive performance will permit you to take advantage of the sauna benefits. This popular model is in high demand. It only requires 14 Amp to get going. Including the best performance infrared heater on the market covering a total area of 3900 Sq in. You will receive the infrared heat required to achieve that better health !
